body.x: InnotionTech participated in the “2024 Future Innovation tech eXpo (FIX 2024)” held from October 23 to October 26 at Daegu EXCO. Specializing in high-performance plasma coating technology for improved durability and performance, InnotionTech provides comprehensive coating systems, materials, and services tailored for products and components in future-focused industries.

At FIX 2024, InnotionTech presented its “High-Performance Plasma Surface Treatment Technology,” which includes advanced hybrid coating systems, high-functionality coating materials, and optimized coating processes. Their applications span future automotive and sensor sectors (motors, gear assemblies, sensors), essential display components (slides, molds, jigs, flexible substrates), battery manufacturing equipment (rollers, slitters), and cosmetics-bio fields (implants, packaging, molds).

The technology reduces manufacturing defects and minimizes arcing in secondary battery components. It also enhances rolling roll durability, achieving over three times the durability of traditional HCr plating. This increases electrode density and reduces manufacturing costs due to improved consumable durability.

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
